en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide urban square bordered by a long row of multi‑story buildings with characteristic enclosed glass balconies (galerías). There are trees along the façade and several horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians in the open plaza. Printed captions identify the place as Plaza de Pontevedra in La Coruña. The lower margin shows the publisher's line, and there is a Spanish postage stamp with a handwritten signature on the right.
